thread:
Aisha (People Ops): Following up from the all-hands Q&A 1: short live thread for hub bookings, offsite ops, and travel clarifications. Keep replies snappy and we'll collate into the handbook.

Ben (Eng): Question: reserving a 4-day team sprint in LA — 5 people — do we call that an offsite or just block desks?

Aisha (People Ops): Offsite request required for multi-day team sprints >=3 people and any meal/venue budget. Use the Offsite Request form: https://intranet.redwood/offsites.

Kara (Design): Can external agency folks use the hubs for a day of workshops? NDA needed?

Aisha (People Ops): Short visits OK with manager approval + visitor pass. Repeated access or workshops that include confidential design reviews require vendor NDA and a sponsor.

Marta (Recruiting): Candidate travel: policy on reimbursing flights vs mileage?

Devon (Finance): Candidates: up to $300 domestic flights or mileage at standard IRS rate if they drive. Pre-approve with Recruiting. Keep receipts.

Facilities-Bot: Tip: desk and room bookings open 60 days ahead; add "AV" option 48h before event for setup.

Ben (Eng): After-hours badge access — I do late deploys some nights — Any special request?

Aisha (People Ops): Register expected after-hours on the Access Portal. For recurring late access, managers should request a badge permission update. Security will verify.

Kara (Design): Offsite meals: any per-person cap and approval path for splurge on team dinner?

Devon (Finance): Default US per-person cap is $250/day for offsite-related costs. Anything above requires People Ops + Finance pre-approval on the Offsite Request. Provide justification for exceptions.

HR-Bot: Handbook updated: Workstyle & Offsite sections edited at 1812345600. Link: https://intranet.redwood/handbook/workstyle

Aisha (People Ops): Quick note on health: symptomatic attendees should stay home; we cover one rapid test per person for company-sponsored multi-day events and allow cancellations up to 72h for health reasons.

Marta (Recruiting): For high-profile candidate interviews that require travel above cap, who signs off?

Devon (Finance): Recruiting + Hiring Manager + Finance. If >$1k, include Director-level approval.

Aisha (People Ops): I'll pin the Offsite Request, budget template, and consent language to #people-ops and fold these answers into the handbook. DM me for visa letters or childcare stipend requests and I'll set a 15-min slot. :thumbsup:
